name: Copperhead
description: The Slice Engineering Copperhead features a bimetallic heatbreak made from copper and stainless steel, providing exceptional thermal conductivity in the melt zone while maintaining a sharp thermal gradient in the cold zone. This design allows higher sustained flow rates compared to traditional all-metal titanium heatbreaks. Compatible with Mosquito-spec mounts and rated to 450°C, it is suited for high-temperature engineering filaments including PEEK and PEI.

heatBreakSpecs.material: stainless steel surgical tubing / copper alloy composite

nozzleSpecs.system: V6 threaded (M6 x 1, 12.5mm length, compatible with E3D V6 and RepRap components)

physicalSpecs.mountType: Groove mount or Mosquito screw mount (M2.5, both variants available)

features: Bimetallic copper heatbreak for high thermal conductivity
Higher sustained flow than titanium all-metal heatbreaks
Mosquito-compatible mount for broad toolhead support
